meaning:
Δεκά-πολις, -εως, ὴ
Decapolis, a region east of the Jordan con­taining ten cities: Mat.4:25, Mrk.5:20 7:31.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
